name: Kinetiq kHYPE StakingManager (HyperEVM)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Kinetiq's flagship staking manager, about $1.05B of DefiLlama TVL at the 2026-09-17 read. Admin roles sit with a 4-of-8 Safe, but a bare EOA holds OPERATOR_ROLE and binds the score. Its oracle push is size-capped.
narrative.tag: same root Safe as kmHYPE and mkts, not in the score
narrative.detail: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE are held by a 4-of-8 Safe with no module, no guard and no delay; TREASURY_ROLE and SENTINEL_ROLE have no holder. The bare-EOA operator can push a report once per validator per 24 h, but a sanity checker caps each push at 3 bps of reward and 1 bp of slash and rejects a balance more than 300 bps from the L1 read. The Safe can loosen or remove the checker with no delay. The same Safe roots kmHYPE and mkts, a real concentration not counted in the score. OPERATOR_ROLE's gated functions were inferred from kmHYPE, not read line by line.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
